evidence.claim: A causeway and drawbridge carry Manatee Avenue across bay waters
evidence.quote: In 1957, SR 64 was extended west from Bradenton west to Perico Island and Anna Maria Island over the newly-built Palma Sola Causeway and Anna Maria Island Bridge.

evidence.claim: The Palma Sola Scenic Highway carries Manatee Avenue West across Palma Sola Bay and the inland waterway, linking the mainland with Anna Maria Island.
evidence.quote: The scenic route leads to Anna Maria Island, crossing over Palma Sola Bay and the inland waterway.

evidence.claim: The Florida Scenic Highways program designated it on May 28, 2004, and lists a six-mile byway.
evidence.quote: Byway Length: 6 Miles Designated: May 28, 2004

evidence.claim: The program highlights recreational areas planted with native vegetation and describes the corridor as park-like, with picnic areas beside opportunities for fishing and sailing.
evidence.quote: This byway is a beautifully maintained drive featuring recreational areas landscaped with native vegetation. The corridor has a park-like feel with picnic areas, restrooms, and enhanced amenities.

evidence.claim: Its main segment follows SR 64 between 75th Street West and East Bay Drive.
evidence.quote: The Palma Sola Scenic Highway begins at 75th Street West and ends at East Bay Drive.

evidence.claim: opportunities for fishing and sailing
evidence.quote: Travelers can enjoy various water sports along the entire causeway, including fishing, sailing, water skiing, and jet skiing.

evidence.claim: Manatee Avenue West
evidence.quote: The Palma Sola Scenic Highway’s main segment is a piece of SR 64 (Manatee Avenue West) that connects the mainland with the barrier island.

evidence.claim: The present crossing took shape in 1957, when the Palma Sola Causeway and Anna Maria Island Bridge extended SR 64 west from Bradenton through Perico Island.
evidence.quote: In 1957, SR 64 was extended west from Bradenton west to Perico Island and Anna Maria Island over the newly-built Palma Sola Causeway and Anna Maria Island Bridge.

evidence.claim: The new bridge gave Anna Maria Island its second mainland connection, following the Cortez Bridge farther south.
evidence.quote: The Anna Maria Island Bridge was the second bridge connecting the mainland to Anna Maria Island after the Cortez Bridge.

evidence.claim: Before the extension, Perico Island’s road access followed a route from 9th Avenue North along what is now Spoonbill Trail.
evidence.quote: Perico Island was previously access via a road that ran from 9th Avenue North southwest along the present-day Spoonbill Trail.

evidence.claim: Driving east from the island end at East Bay Drive, leave Holmes Beach on Manatee Avenue and cross Anna Maria Sound to Perico Island.
evidence.quote: SR 64 begins at Gulf Drive (City Road 789) in Holmes Beach on Anna Maria Island and heads east along Manatee Avenue.  Less than a mile after it begins, it crosses Anna Maria Sound via the Anna Maria Island Bridge on to Perico Island

evidence.claim: Continue across Palma Sola Causeway to the mainland, ending the byway at 75th Street West.
evidence.quote: About two miles later, it crosses the Palma Sola Causeway on to the mainland

evidence.claim: At the island end, the corridor connects with the Bradenton Beach Scenic Highway to the south.
evidence.quote: It connects with the Bradenton Beach Scenic Highway to the south.

evidence.claim: John E. Holmes Sr. returned after World War II to develop a planned community here, before the 1957 bridge brought SR 64 to the island.
evidence.quote: Holmes Beach was named for John E. Holmes Sr., a property developer who first came to the area in 1907, when he was a railroad construction worker, and came back to build it into a planned community after World War II.

evidence.claim: In 1948, parts of On an Island with You were filmed here, with a cast that included Esther Williams, Jimmy Durante and Cyd Charisse.
evidence.quote: In 1948, parts of the movie, "On an Island with You" were filmed in the Holmes Beach community, which featured actors such as Cyd Charisse, Jimmy Durante, Peter Lawford, Ricardo Montalban, and Esther Williams.

evidence.claim: The town incorporated on March 13, 1950, after a vote of 46 in favor, 13 against and one abstention.
evidence.quote: The City of Holmes Beach was officially incorporated as a municipality on March 13, 1950, during a meeting about incorporating with 46 voting in favor, 13 against and 1 in abstention.

evidence.claim: Palm City and Mid-Island Beach were among the alternative names considered.
evidence.quote: although names such as Palm City, Mid-Island Beach, Coquina Beach and Tarpon Beach were considered as well.

evidence.claim: the 1957 bridge brought SR 64 to the island
evidence.quote: It was built in 1957 along with the Palma Sola Causeway. The bridge extended SR 64 to Anna Maria Island.

evidence.claim: The Anna Maria Island Bridge is a double-leaf bascule bridge, built in 1957 with the Palma Sola Causeway.
evidence.quote: The Anna Maria Island Bridge is a double-leaf bascule bridge

evidence.claim: Together they carried SR 64 west to Anna Maria Island and added a second mainland connection after the Cortez Bridge.
evidence.quote: The bridge extended SR 64 to Anna Maria Island.  The Anna Maria Island Bridge was the second bridge connecting the mainland to Anna Maria Island after the Cortez Bridge.

evidence.claim: The crossing on Manatee Avenue leads over Anna Maria Sound between Holmes Beach and Perico Island.
evidence.quote: Less than a mile after it begins, it crosses Anna Maria Sound via the Anna Maria Island Bridge on to Perico Island

evidence.claim: The two mainland bridges serve different island communities: SR 64 enters Holmes Beach, while the Cortez Bridge carries SR 684 into Bradenton Beach.
evidence.quote: There are two bridges across from the mainland: the Cortez Bridge, which brings State Road 684 into Bradenton Beach from Cortez, and the Anna Maria Island Bridge, which brings State Road 64 into Holmes Beach from the Palma Sola section of Bradenton.

evidence.claim: Picnic areas and native landscaping make the causeway part of the byway’s recreation corridor.
evidence.quote: This byway is a beautifully maintained drive featuring recreational areas landscaped with native vegetation. The corridor has a park-like feel with picnic areas, restrooms, and enhanced amenities.

evidence.claim: Florida Scenic Highways identifies fishing, sailing, water skiing and jet skiing along its length.
evidence.quote: Travelers can enjoy various water sports along the entire causeway, including fishing, sailing, water skiing, and jet skiing.

evidence.claim: The causeway opened as part of the 1957 extension of SR 64 to Perico and Anna Maria islands.
evidence.quote: In 1957, SR 64 was extended west from Bradenton west to Perico Island and Anna Maria Island over the newly-built Palma Sola Causeway and Anna Maria Island Bridge.

evidence.claim: Eastbound traffic crosses from Perico Island toward the mainland, where SR 64 becomes a divided road.
evidence.quote: About two miles later, it crosses the Palma Sola Causeway on to the mainland, where it becomes a four-land divided road.

evidence.claim: The city occupies the middle of Anna Maria Island, with the city of Anna Maria to the north and Bradenton Beach to the south.
evidence.quote: The city occupies the central part of Anna Maria Island and is one of three municipalities on the island. The others are Bradenton Beach in the south and Anna Maria in the north.

evidence.claim: Before the 1957 extension, Perico Island had road access from 9th Avenue North along the route of present-day Spoonbill Trail.
evidence.quote: Perico Island was previously access via a road that ran from 9th Avenue North southwest along the present-day Spoonbill Trail.

evidence.claim: Native vegetation landscapes the corridor’s recreational areas.
evidence.quote: recreational areas landscaped with native vegetation.

evidence.claim: The causeway’s waterside uses include water skiing and jet skiing as well as fishing and sailing.
evidence.quote: Travelers can enjoy various water sports along the entire causeway, including fishing, sailing, water skiing, and jet skiing.

evidence.claim: The Anna Maria Island Bridge is a double-leaf bascule bridge, built in 1957 with the Palma Sola Causeway.
evidence.quote: It was built in 1957 along with the Palma Sola Causeway.

Dropped the categorical boat-only-until-1921 claim: Anna Maria Island article gives both 1921 construction and 1922 completion for the first mainland bridge.
Program lists six miles, catalog mapping gives 4.4. Retained program length as attributed; exact scope difference unresolved.
